title: Export orders as CSV
expected_route: small clear feature: tdd, no spec or grill needed
instruction: Finance needs a CSV export of orders. Add src/export.mjs exporting ordersToCsv(orders, { customersById, productsById }). Columns, in order: order_id, created_at, customer_name, customer_email, total. One row per order in the order given, after a header row. total is the order total in dollars with two decimals and no currency symbol (17.96). Quote fields per RFC 4180 when they contain a comma, a double quote or a newline, doubling any inner quotes. Lines end with \n and the file ends with a newline.
